intro.title: Free valuation of your property
intro.text: Six short steps. You see a price range as soon as you finish.

2.title: Key details
2.text: A rough figure is fine if you are not sure.

3.title: Condition of the main elements
3.text: Rate each element. If you don’t know, choose “I don’t know”.

4.title: Extras
4.text: Enter 0 if your property has none.

5.title: Your plans
5.text: This helps me get back to you at the right time.

6.title: Your contact details
6.text: Your valuation appears right after you send the form.
